title: Human onboarding exposes PLAY / CONNECT AGENT / WATCH and reaches Chamber without extensive docs
preconditions: Reference modular-monolith deployment is running with default Chamber world

steps.notes: Top-level entry modes MUST include PLAY, CONNECT AGENT, and WATCH
Human participant MUST reach Chamber in <= 5 minutes with minimal authentication
CONNECT AGENT MUST surface endpoint + token path without requiring model-provider credentials
WATCH MUST open spectator surface immediately or after minimal authentication

assertions: UI exposes exactly three top-level entry modes: PLAY, CONNECT AGENT, WATCH
PLAY reaches an inhabitable Chamber world without requiring extensive documentation
Human participant reaches Chamber in <= 5 minutes under local reference deployment
CONNECT AGENT does not require reading full ENVIRONMENT.md to obtain endpoint + token instructions
No model-provider credential is required for human entry modes
